SCE.S:3CD054: From Sicily. Drifted here while roaming the world as a hippie. Lives by the sea with his girlfriend.
SCE.S:3CD120: Born in Milan. Came to work here via manager Luigi. A first-class cook; pizza is his forte.
SCE.S:3CD1EC: Grad student at the west university, in Italian art history. Eats lunch here to practice Italian.
SCE.S:3CD2B8: Joined the mining firm out of high school. Even in decline, working here helps marriage prospects.
